newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 364-day bills average accepted yield 5.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 364-day bills average accepted yield 5.77 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 364-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.77 percent, said the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA).
This compares with 12-month HIBOR of 6.30288 percent at 0330 GMT and 5.56 percent at the last monthly tender on August 6.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue rose to HK$3.37 billion from HK$2.06 billion.
The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's weekly tender was 5.20 percent, the HKMA said.
This compares with three-month HIBOR of 5.66346 percent at 0330 GMT and and the average accepted yield of 5.14 percent at the previous tender.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue rose to HK$4.87 billion from HK$4.68 billion a week ago.
